title: II.Pr.3: Prelude in C# major (final fugal section)

groocock.chapter: 9 Group 3: Fugues for Three Voices, with Stretto

entries.notes: no definite ending; may be considered to last until bar 28; voice not stated in text (review table p.81 shows exposition "STR S /" keys I, I-V I)
in close stretto with the subject; bars not given
starts a note too high, reverts to subject intervals with the quaver leaps
followed a bar later by the inverted subject figure
culminates in falling chromatic scale passage bars 44-46
in stretto as at the opening, positions interchanged

episodes.material: bass uses inverted subject figure, imitated by upper voices

coda: after bar 46 (allusions to inverted subject figure)

countersubjects.notes: listed among fugues without countersubject (p.11, bars 25-50)

subject.ends: no definite ending; may be considered to last until bar 28
subject.notes: three-part fugato ending the prelude; ch.2 p.5 lists II.Pr.3 (bars 25-50) among answers entering a perfect fourth lower; it is not in the answer-type table p.10

claims.claim: Short three-part fugato; answer in close stretto; single episode bars 34-37.
